page.overview:
Who is Khyber?

In his Street Fighter V profile, he is a dangerous heavyweight assault soldier. He has a pair of gauntlet-like flamethrowers on his wrists that are connected to a [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napalm Napalm] tank on his back, and a flaming weapon hidden in his mouth. He also has a short temper, being prone to burning things he doesn't like.

Khyber specializes in pyrotechnics and is equipped with a flamethrower hidden inside his mask. He uses special techniques that resemble the ones used by Dhalsim (a character who was not featured in the game) such as the Assault Fire, Assault Flame and Assault Blast.
